confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from a few web searches. For Munnar itself, traveller-crowdsourced budget data put meals at about $2–6 for lunch and $5–11 for dinner, and coffee at about $1. I found no Munnar-specific price for beer, cocktails or wine, so those are based on nearby Kerala and hill-station data: a domestic pint costs about INR 150 (about $1.78) in Kochi and about $1.65 in Kottayam, and nearby hill towns show roughly $1–2.30 for beer and $0.90–1.30 for cappuccino. Kerala sells alcohol only through licensed bars and resorts with high state taxes, and draft beer is uncommon, so the beer anchor is set above city averages to reflect bar and resort pricing in a tourist hill station. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from typical Indian ratios to beer and from bar and resort pricing, so they are the least certain anchors. Cappuccino is set above the plain-coffee figure because tourist cafés charge more. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates and were not checked against live listings. They reflect July, which is monsoon low season in Munnar and usually brings softer room rates. Registered hostels are few in Munnar, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Munnar traveller budget data, adjusted using Kerala cities Kochi and Kottayam and nearby Western Ghats hill stations such as Coonoor and Valparai. Prices are pushed up modestly because Munnar is a tourist hill station and Kerala restricts alcohol sales.
